Shield Trigger
■ Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your darkness, fire or nature creatures. (If a card is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature.)
■ When you put this as an evolution creature or it becomes an evolution source, choose one of your opponent's elements that costs 3 or less and destroy it.
